findings.description: Target is l.uri.empty()?r.target:l.uri+path.substr(l.path.size())+query. On an exact match the remainder is empty, so GET /api?cmd=whoami emits GET /exec?cmd=whoami HTTP/1.1, three tokens; a strict parser executes whoami, and bare GET /api executes id. No encoding. Requires a URI naming the route with no trailing space, exact match and a strict reader.
findings.title: An exact-match URI leaves the configured exec route as the whole token 1, so an attacker query alone executes a chosen command with no encoding

limitations: Needs exact match and strict reader
methods: Strict peer with verbatim line, token count and exact 3-token exec
